items.title: Beta 0.4.0 — calmer and more useful
items.body: Much less motion and softer colours. New AI tab for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more; a clipboard history with the time and website of everything you copy; live volume, brightness, Caps Lock and download activity in the island; and you can drag the island anywhere.

items.title: Move the island
items.body: Grab the closed island — or the tab bar of the open one — and drop it anywhere. Drop it near the top centre to send it home.

items.title: Updates are now required
items.body: When a new version is out, the island asks you to update before you continue. It takes a minute and restarts by itself.
